title: Penny Dreadful Nerd Block Exclusive Variant Comic Titan Comics 2017 Vanessa Ives
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penny Dreadful - Nerd Block exclusive variant (Titan Comics, 2017), based on the Showtime series. Cover shows Vanessa Ives (Eva Green) with Sir Malcolm and the show's monsters; "Presented by Nerd Block" on the cover.

Back cover: Anno Dracula 1895: Seven Days in Mayhem ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
